input.rationale: Section 9 ("Warranties") contains only mutual corporate representations (organization, authority, enforceability, no conflicts) at p0056–p0057 and an HDI acknowledgement regarding the Globix Agreement at p0058. Nowhere in the Agreement (including HDI's Responsibilities in Sections 1.1–1.8 and the Site management provisions in Section 5) does HDI warrant that the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, that the Site will conform to approved specifications or documentation for any period, or provide any repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy; there is also no compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranty running to us. That fails the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies) because there is no conformance warranty or remedy at all. Mitigating factor: there is no "AS IS" disclaimer, so this is not walk-away territory, and Section 1.6 gives us a termination right if the Site is not operational on time. Redline inserts a new Section 9(c) at the preferred position (professional and workmanlike Services, 90-day conformance warranty for the Site, compliance with laws, no malicious code, with repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy at HDI's option); a shorter conformance period is available as a fallback.

proposal.summary: Add an HDI performance/conformance warranty with repair, replace or refund remedy in Section 9.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 contains only mutual corporate authority representations, so HDI gives no warranty at all for the Site or the hosting Services; we added a standard performance and conformance warranty with a repair, replace, re-perform or refund remedy, plus compliance with laws and no malicious code. If helpful, we can accept a ninety (90) day conformance period for the Site as a fallback.

ops.text: (c) HDI represents and warrants to the Company that (1) the Services (including the design, development, implementation, operation, maintenance, management and hosting of the Site) will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (2) for a period of ninety (90) days following the Effective Date, the Site will conform in all material respects to the specifications and Content approved by the Company pursuant to Section 5.2 and to any documentation provided by HDI; (3) HDI will perform the Services in compliance with all applicable laws, rules and regulations; and (4) the Site and any software provided by HDI will not contain any virus, worm, disabling code or other malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of this warranty shall be, at HDI's option, re-performance of the non-conforming Services, repair or replacement of the non-conforming portion of the Site, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services.
